headline: Samsung authors report UVM-based mixed-signal verification of an OLED display PMIC
fact: A DVCon Europe 2023 paper by Samsung authors reports a UVM-based mixed-signal verification environment for an OLED display power-management IC. The authors describe 45 validated wreal models, 142 tests, assertions and automated checks, a fifteen-week turnaround, and defects including pin mismatches found during the verification effort.

sources.title: UVM-Based Mixed-Signal Verification of a Display PMIC Designed for OLED Display Applications
sources.summary: DVCon's record identifies the Samsung OLED display PMIC UVM mixed-signal verification paper.
